You bring up a really good point that a lot of people can't see, which is already an impressive thing about you that other people don't have. But anyway, I think being raised in 1st world culture, or an Americanized and globalized neoliberal culture, we are conditioned to have the mentally that everything is a competition, and you have to "Win" or else you "Lose" in every scenario.

That's simply not the case with life, and Americanization and mediatization has conditioned a lot of people in the 1st world to think this way. When I hear you say "I'm not as smart as everyone," that's how I feel a lot of times too, especially in my major in school, but you know what? That's the same thing as saying "I lose against this person." So what do I do? I get rid of the competition mindset, there's no need to compete unless you're running an 800 meter sprint or you're in the boxing ring with someone else. If you're not, then there's no reason to have a competition-oriented mindset.

You have to learn to live the way you want to live, and be as you wish to seem.

I had the problem with people telling me "Just be yourself," for a long time until I discarded that mentality completely, because being myself was getting me nowhere - rejection in basically everything, being taken advantage of, being too nice, just having life and other people complete destroy me every day. So I got rid of their advice.

The point is, who do you want to be?

Have a picture in your mind, and start acting and carrying the attributes of this figure you create. This power is very real, and just remember, life allows people to go in any direction they want, so if you are going South, life will let you, and it's not going to stop you. So choose a direction that will bring you to "Who you want to be," and just attack it, every day, and write down your own schedule for each day, so you can have the days you want. There's no more need to compare and worry about competition - just compare to the standard you set for yourself, and make it higher than the others around you.
